recipe.title: Three Minute Tomato Sauce
instructions: Put a pan on full heat and add a lug of oil.
Add the garlic and chilli to the pan.
Add the chopped basil stalks and tomatoes, crushing them by hand.
Clean out the tin with a little water and add it to the sauce.
Use fresh lasagna sheets or any pasta you want, cut into different shapes (tagliolini, tagliotelli, papadelli) or cut badly.
Cook the pasta in seasoned water, adding a little of the starchy water from the sauce.
Cook the pasta for the last 30 seconds in the sauce and toss it up.
Drain the pasta and add it back into the sauce, tossing it well.
Serve with Parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil, and feta cheese.
